in_marathi.name: Chandar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandar is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Chandra', meaning moon. In Hindu mythology, Chandar is the name of the moon god. He is often depicted as a crescent moon on a bull, and is believed to control tides and weather.
